source: 789 At the Stake
target: 789 Ad Stipam

source: 789 At the Stake
target: 789 Ad Stipam

source: Jenna observed Rabbit Chasel, who increasingly resembled Gehrman Sparrow, and carefully asked, “What do you need this time?”
target: Jenna observavit Rabbit Chasel, qui magis magisque Gehrman Sparrow similis fieri incipit, et caute rogavit: “Quid hoc tempore tibi opus est?”

source: One of the later volumes of The Great Adventurer? Or something else?
target: Unum ex volumina posterioribus Magni Adventuratoris? An alia?

source: Luckily, few people knew about her messenger, and Rabbit Chasel didn’t deliver messages frequently.
target: Felix, pauci de eius nuntio sciebant, et Rabbit Chasel nuntia non frequenter tradebat.

source: Otherwise, Jenna would have to consider providing different knowledge.
target: Alioquin, Jenna diversa scientia praebere cogitavisset.

source: Rabbit Chasel lowered its paw holding the revolver and said in a thoughtful tone, “Get me a pair of boxing gloves that a rabbit can wear.”
target: Rabbit Chasel pedem, qui revolver tenebat, deiecit et cogitans in tono dixit: “Adfer mihi pariam manicarum pugilatoriārum, quas lepus gerere possit.”

source: What kind of request is that?
target: Qualis petitio ista est?

source: Lumian said with a chuckle, “I don’t remember Gehrman Sparrow ever wearing boxing gloves.”
target: Lumian subrisus dixit: “Non memini Gehrman Sparrow umquam manicas pugilatorias indutum fuisse.”

source: This imitation doesn’t quite fit the persona!
target: Haec imitatio non perfecte personae convenit!

source: “True, but Gehrman Sparrow has Blazing Danitz.
target: “Vere, sed Gehrman Sparrow Danitz Igneus habet.

source: I need my own Danitz.
target: Ego meam Danitz propriam requiro.

source: I want to develop one in our community,” Rabbit Chasel explained earnestly.
target: Unam in nostra communitate evolvere volo, sincere explanavit Rabbit Chasel.

source: “Danitz uses boxing gloves.”
target: “Danitz manicas pugilatorias utitur.”

source: For a moment, Franca, Jenna, and Lumian didn’t know how to respond.
target: Per momentum, Franca, Jenna, et Lumian nesciverunt quomodo respondeant.

source: After several seconds, Jenna nodded and said, “I’ll have a pair custom-made for you. Mm, normal Rabbit of Knowledge size, not your size?”
target: Post aliquot secundos, Jenna annuit et dixit: “Paria tibi ex consilio fabricata parabo. Mm, magnitudine normali Leporis Scientiae, non tua?”

source: “That’s right.” Rabbit Chasel raised its right hand, blew on the small revolver’s muzzle, satisfied.
target: “Recte.” Rabbit Chasel dextram manum elevavit et super parvum tubum revolveris flatus dedit, contentus.

source: But… this gesture isn’t fitting for the current scene… Franca noticed that Rabbit Chasel was still an immature Rabbit of Knowledge, mimicking and repeating much without truly mastering it.
target: Sed… hic gestus scaenam praesentem non convenit… Franca animadvertit quod Rabbit Chasel adhuc immaturus Lepus Scientiae esset, multum imitans et repetens, sed vere non dominatus.

source: In the darkness of Banamo Port, only a few street lamps with candles flickered.
target: In obscuritate Portus Banamo, tantum paucae lampades viarias cum candelis micabant.

source: Pirates gathered in bars, drinking heavily or going upstairs with women, enjoying pleasures unavailable at sea.
target: Piratae in tabernis congregabantur, graviter bibentes aut cum mulieribus in superiores conclavia ascendentes, voluptatibus fruentes, quae in mari inaccessae erant.

source: With the Newins gone and the unknown adventurer disappeared, the pirates gradually put the incident behind them.
target: Cum Newins discessissent et adventurator ignotus evanuerit, piratae rem illam paulatim relegaverunt.

source: After all, everyone felt embarrassed; no one would ridicule another.
target: Post omnia, omnes erubuerunt; nemo alterum deridebat.

source: As pirates, they knew they might die in a storm, during a robbery, or in a mutiny on their next voyage.
target: Ut piratae, noverunt se in tempestate, rapina, aut seditione in proximis itineribus interiri posse.

source: Dwelling on past problems was meaningless; indulging in the present was the only option.
target: De quaestionibus praeteritis versari nihil prodest; in praesenti solum fruendum optimum erat.

source: Of course, they also talked about the unknown adventurer’s strength and what had happened inside the Newins, wondering why Admiral Deep Sea fled in such a hurry.
target: Certe etiam de virtute adventurantis ignoti et de rebus quae in Newins acciderant loquebantur, mirantes cur Admiralis Profundi Maris tam festinanter fugeret.

source: “I think that adventurer was waiting for Admiral Deep Sea!”
target: “Credo illum adventurarem Admiralem Profundi Maris exspectavisse!”

source: “Does he want to recreate Gehrman Sparrow’s great feats?”
target: “Num vult res gestas Gehrman Sparrow recreare?”

source: “Pui! Son of a bitch. What great feats? We’re pirates!”
target: “Vah! Filius canis. Quae res gestae magnæ? Piratae sumus!”

source: “He succeeded but didn’t completely succeed? He defeated Admiral Deep Sea but let him escape?”
target: “Vicit, sed non omnino? Admiralem Profundi Maris vicit, sed eum effugere permisit?”

source: “Is he close to the power of the Kings?”
target: “Num prope potentiam regum sit?”

source: “What’s happening on the sea? Every so often, a powerful adventurer appears! There was that Louis Berry before, too.”
target: “Quid agitur in mari? Quoties aliquando adventurator potens apparet! Erat etiam ille Louis Berry antea.”

source: Disguised as a non-pirate, Mason mingled in several bars, listening to the pirates discuss recent events, hoping they’d start a fight.
target: Se non pirata simulans, Mason in pluribus tabernis miscuit, auscultans piratas de recentibus rebus disputantes, sperans eos pugnam inchoare.

source: On his way to the next bar, Mason turned into a quieter alley and saw a figure standing ahead, seemingly waiting for him.
target: In itinere ad proximam tabernam, Mason in vico angusto se contulit et figuram ante se stantem vidit, quasi eum exspectans.

source: The figure had black hair and blue eyes, with sharp features and a handsome face.
target: Figura capillos nigros, oculos caeruleos, lineamenta acuta, et vultum formosum habebat.

source: It was the same unknown adventurer who had challenged all the pirates in Banamo Port and forced Admiral Deep Sea to flee.
target: Erat eadem adventurator ignotus, qui omnes piratas Portus Banamo provocaverat et Admiralem Profundi Maris ad fugam compulit.

source: Mason suddenly heard his heart pounding and blurted out, “I’m not a pirate!”
target: Mason subito cor suum pulsantem audivit et exclamavit: “Non sum pirata!”

source: Lumian strolled forward and smiled. “I have a task for you.”
target: Lumian procedebat et subridebat. “Tibi munus habeo.”

source: Hearing this, Mason relaxed a bit and carefully said, “What can I do for you? I’m not sure if my abilities can meet your needs.”
target: Hoc audito, Mason paulo relaxavit et caute dixit: “Quid tibi facere possum? Non certus sum an facultates meae necessitatibus tuis satisfacere possint.”

source: He feared that while completing the task might be easy, the aftermath could be problematic—pirates might hack him to pieces once the adventurer left.
target: Timebat, dum munus absolvendum facile esse posset, postea res arduae fieri, nam piratae eum in frusta caedere possent, simul adventurator discessisset.

source: Lumian said bluntly, “It’s a simple and secret task. Keep an eye on Banamo Port. As soon as the Newins returns or you spot Great Shark Jörg and his men, summon my messenger immediately.”
target: Lumian aperte dixit: “Munus simplex et secretum est. Intuere Portum Banamo. Quotiens Newins redierit aut Magnum Squalum Jörg cum viris eius agnoscas, statim nuntium meum invoca.”

source: Hearing “messenger,” Mason was suddenly struck by a thought.
target: Audito “nuntio,” Mason subito cogitatione percussus est.

source: He remembered his last task: summoning a terrifying messenger through a ritual!
target: Meminit sui ultimi muneris: nuntium terribilem per ritum evocare!

source: Unable to control his expression, Mason asked in slight terror, “Are you Lumian Lee, sir?”
target: Nondum velle vultum suum regere, Mason leviter territus rogavit: “Esne Lumian Lee, domine?”

source: The master of that terrifying messenger?
target: Dominus illius nuntii terribilis?

source: “Perceptive,” Lumian replied, not too sincerely.
target: “Perspicax,” Lumian respondit, non nimis ex animo.

source: Mason connected the recent events in his mind: Was the real purpose of that task to bring Lumian Lee to Banamo Port?
target: Mason nupera eventa in mente coniunxit: Num verum propositum illius muneris esset Lumian Lee ad Portum Banamo adducere?

source: And Lumian Lee’s goal was to deal with Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, for the Lost Newins?
target: Et propositum Lumian Lee erat agere contra Admiralem Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, pro Newins perditis?

source: My spiritual intuition was partly correct; the ritual indeed brought something bad to Banamo Port, though it didn’t turn into a catastrophe…
target: Intuitio spiritua mea partim recte fuit; ritus re vera aliquid mali ad Portum Banamo attulit, licet in calamitatem non versa sit.

source: Lumian continued, “The payment is 5000 verl d’or.”
target: Lumian continuavit: “Solutio est 5000 verl d’or.”

source: The task is indeed simple, and I likely wouldn’t be discovered by the pirates.
target: Munus quidem simplex est, et verisimiliter piratae me non deprehenderent.

source: The reward is generous…
target: Praemium est largum…

source: If I refused, knowing the task details might bring trouble…
target: Si recusarem, cognoscere minuta muneris fortasse incommodum afferrem…

source: After weighing it for over ten seconds, Mason said, “No problem, I think I can handle this task.”
target: Postquam per plus quam decem secundos deliberavit, Mason inquit: “Nulla quaestio, puto me hoc munus perficere posse.”

source: Lumian nodded slightly, paid a 1000-verl d’or deposit, and turned to leave the quiet alley.
target: Lumian parum annuit, cautionem depositi 1000 verl d’or solvit, et vicum quietum reliquens discessit.

source: Watching Lumian’s figure disappear into the darkness, Mason silently repeated his name, “Lumian Lee, Lumian Lee…”
target: Videns figuram Lumiani in tenebras evanescere, Mason tacite nomen suum repetivit: “Lumian Lee, Lumian Lee…”

source: Mason finally remembered where he had heard the name: on a wanted poster aboard a ship!
target: Denique Mason meminit ubi nomen audisset: in tabella desideratorum in nave!

source: The poster described Lumian Lee as a survivor of a sacrificial ritual to an evil god that destroyed a village, severely corrupted by the evil god.
target: Tabella describebat Lumian Lee ut superstitium ritus sacrificii deo malo, qui vicum deleverat, graviter corruptum ab eo deo.

source: In Trier, in the prison district, at the Rois Comprehensive Execution Ground.
target: In Trier, in regione carceraria, ad Campum Exsecutionis Rois.

source: Returning to Trier for two days, Franca, feeling ready for the Demoness of Affliction advancement ritual, decided to proceed.
target: Rediens ad Trier per duas dies, Franca, se ad ritum progressionis Demonissae Afflictionis paratam sentiens, destinavit procedere.

source: 007’s lead on the Mirror People came from an ore scholar of the Trier Cave Association.
target: Indictum 007 de Populo Specularium provenit ab erudito Associationis Speluncarum Treiensium.

source: The Purifiers had planned to investigate all the association’s ore scholars, but one had mysteriously disappeared before they could visit.
target: Purificatores consilium tenuerant omnes eruditos associationis Speculorum minerali investigare, sed unus, mysterio, evanuerat antequam visitari possent.

source: Recently, someone had seen her in Underground Trier, suspected to be Palia, a Mirror Person.
target: Nuper, aliquis eam in Trier Subterraneo vidit, suspiciens eam esse Palia, Personam Specularis.

source: Franca looked at the stake and sighed sincerely, “When I became a witch, I wondered if I’d end up burned at the stake. Who knew, I have to tie myself up here?”
target: Franca stipam aspexit et sincere suspiravit: “Cum striga facta essem, mirabar num in stipam cremata finirem. Quis scivit me hic me ipsum alligare oportere?”

source: As she spoke, she took out the brown-red wooden suitcase given by Demoness of Black Clarice from the Traveler’s Bag and unlocked the metal clasp.
target: Dum loquebatur, capsam ligneam fusco-rubram ab Demonissa Nigrae Clarice ex Sacculo Viatoris data extraxit et cingulum metallicum aperuit.

source: Next, she retrieved a red wine glass, crushed the crystalline ice containing potion ingredients, and poured in Flower-Faced Bat blood and human blood from a seriously ill person.
target: Deinde vitrum vini rubri obtinuit, glaciem crystallinam, quae potionis ingredientes contineret, conterit, et effudit sanguinem vespertilionis faciei floridae et sanguinem humanum ex aegroto graviter affecto.

source: Both were dark red, and when combined, they turned almost black.
target: Utraque obscuro rubra erant, et cum coniuncta sunt, fere in nigritudinem versa sunt.

source: She then added the Flower-Faced Bat’s head, a Two-Tailed Black Snake’s gallbladder and tail tip, and ten drops of Enfinitas Eucalyptus essential oil.
target: Deinde addidit caput vespertilionis faciei floridae, vesicam bilii anguis nigri duplici caudatu et apicem caudae, atque decem guttas olei essentialis Enfinitas Eucalyptus.

source: As the ingredients were added, the dark red blood in the glass turned pitch black, with occasional nauseating green bubbles.
target: Cum ingredientia addebantur, sanguis obscuro ruber in vitreo in nigritudinem totam versa est, cum interdum bullis viridibus nauseabundis.

source: “It’s like a cup of untreated sewage,” Lumian commented honestly.
target: “Instar poculi limi non purgati est,” Lumian honeste commentatus est.

source: “Dammit! Shut up!” Franca grew more disgusted as she looked at the Demoness of Affliction potion.
target: “Heu! Tace!” Franca, potionem Demonissae Afflictionis aspiciens, magis turbata facta est.

source: She handed the potion to Lumian and lightly jumped onto the stake, tying herself up with Jenna’s help.
target: Potiionem illam Lumiani tradidit et leviter in stipam insiluit, se cum auxilio Jennae alligans.

source: During this, Franca muttered, “Damn, this feels so weird…”
target: Interea, Franca submurmuravit: “Maledictum, hoc tam insolitum videtur…”

source: She adjusted her mindset for several seconds and nodded to Lumian, “I’m ready.”
target: Postquam per aliquos secundos animum temperavit, Lumiani annuit et dixit: “Parata sum.”

source: Lumian handed the potion to Jenna and extended his right palm.
target: Lumian potionem ad Jenna tradidit et dextram manum protulit.

source: A ball of crimson-white flames flew out, landing on Franca, who immediately felt pain.
target: Globulus flammarum rubro-albae eiecit et in Francam incidit, quae statim dolorem sensit.

source: Her body instinctively wanted to dodge and contract, but the ropes held her firmly.
target: Corpus eius instinctu vitare et contrahere conari volebat, sed funes eam firmiter teneabant.

source: Jenna quickly jumped to her side, one hand holding the ropes and the other bringing the potion to her mouth.
target: Jenna celeriter ad eam accessit, una manu funes tenens et altera potionem ad os suum afferens.

source: Franca forced herself to gulp down the pathogen-like dark-green potion.
target: Franca se coegit ut potionem obscuro-viridem, quasi pathogeno similem, deglutiret.

source: Whether from the flames or the potion, her head quickly grew hot, and her mind became fuzzy from the heat.
target: Sive ex flammarum sive ex potioni, caput eius celeriter calefactus est, et mens eius calore confusa facta est.

source: She involuntarily recalled past pleasures, including her own experiences and the feedback from her partners.
target: Involuntarie recordata sunt ei voluptates praeteritae, inter quas propriae experientiae et responsiones sociorum.

source: At that moment, Franca was both the giver and receiver of pleasure, drowning in it from body to soul, almost dissolving like spring water.
target: Illo momento, Franca et deditrix et receptrix voluptatis erat, ea inundata ab corpore ad animam, paene quasi aqua verni liquefacta.

source: Her thoughts drifted, her will sank, and her self was lost in various intense pleasures.
target: Eius cogitationes vagabantur, eius voluntas deficit, atque ipsa in variis voluptatibus intensis amissa est.

source: However, the pain accompanying those pleasures kept her slightly conscious.
target: Attamen, dolor illos voluptatibus comitans eam parum consciam retinuit.

source: It was the mental resistance and spiritual conflict with Gardner Martin, the emotional gap with Jenna, as if they could never truly unite body and soul…
target: Erat resistentia mentis atque conflictu spirituali cum Gardner Martin, intervallum affectivum cum Jenna, quasi numquam vere corpus et animam coniungere possent…

source: The extreme pain from the burning flames on her body was like invisible threads pulling her self and consciousness, making her sway like a kite in a storm, not completely out of control.
target: Extremus dolor ex flammarum ardor in corpore eius erat velut fila invisibilia, quae ipsam et conscientiam trahent, faciens ut quasi papilio in tempestate vacillaret, non omnino imperio soluto.

source: Swaying, Franca instinctively cursed in her mind:
target: Vacillans, Franca instinctu in mente maledixit:

source: Damn, it hurts so much!
target: Heu, tam multum dolet!

source: This ritual is trying to kill me, isn’t it?
target: Hoc ritus me interficere conatur, nonne?

source: Cough, cough, hot smoke in my throat and lungs, so uncomfortable. Am I dying…
target: Tussis, tussis, fumus calidus in fauce et pulmonibus meis, tam incommodus. Moriensne sum…

source: Dammit, I can say I smell good now, like food, the scent of roasted meat…
target: Heu, nunc possum dicere me bene odorare, instar cibi, odorem carnis assae…

source: Lumian, Jenna, and Anthony stood before the stake, watching Franca’s body gradually turn black and her expression twist beyond beauty.
target: Lumian, Jenna, et Anthony ante stipam steterunt, videntes corpus Francae paulatim nigrescere et vultum eius ultra formosum torquere.

source: Even Lugano, ready to provide medical help, felt a bit heated, their minds wandering with certain thoughts and urges.
target: Etiam Lugano, auxilium medicum praebere paratus, paulo fervens sensit, et mentesque eius quorundam cogitationibus atque impulsibus vagantes erant.

source: Facing this horrifying scene, they had inappropriate desires.
target: Hac terribili visione, desideria impropria in eos erant.

source: Fortunately, it wasn’t severe and was bearable.
target: Fortunate, non ita grave erat et tolerabile videbatur.

source: After several more seconds, the crimson flames on Franca’s body turned pitch black, then into crystalline ice shards, falling off in pieces.
target: Post aliquos secundos additos, flammas coccineas in corpore Francae in nigritudinem totam versa sunt, deinde in fragmenta glacies crystallinae, quae in partes cadebant.

source: The shards took the charred skin with them, revealing Franca’s new, tender, and glistening skin underneath.
target: Fragmenta cutem combustam secuta sunt, patefaciens novam, teneram, et nitidam cutem Francae sub ea.

source: Even with his Ascetic’s endurance, Lumian instinctively looked away.
target: Etiam cum patientia ascetica, Lumian instinctu oculos avertit.
